title: Exposed or fallen electrical wire
guidance: Stay well away from the wire and any nearby objects that may be energized.
Warn other people from a safe distance; do not touch or attempt to move the wire.
Contact the local electricity emergency service or appropriate emergency authority.
Provide the exact location and safe-distance photographs if available.

title: Pothole or damaged road
guidance: Record the road name and nearest landmark.
Describe the approximate size and whether the damage creates immediate danger.
Submit the complaint to the authority responsible for that road.
evidence: Photograph of the damage, if safe

title: Garbage accumulation or missed collection
department: Municipal sanitation or solid-waste management department
guidance: Record the collection point or affected street.
Mention how long the waste has remained uncollected.
Report persistent accumulation to the responsible municipal authority.
evidence: Photograph of the waste, if appropriate

title: Water leakage or supply issue
department: Local water supply department or utility
guidance: Record the affected street or nearby landmark.
Describe whether the issue is leakage, interruption, or water quality.
Report suspected contamination promptly to the responsible water utility.

title: Blocked drain or waterlogging
guidance: Record the affected location and extent of waterlogging.
Mention whether access to homes or roads is obstructed.
Avoid entering deep or moving floodwater.
